title: Studio maintenance and evidence rules
author: FrameCoreWorks

Source checks, publication, saved readback and fresh-client behavior are distinct.

limitations: Repository rules treated as source evidence; explicit research-only task controls execution.

title: FrameCut project JSON shape
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Project schema_version is integer 1, with id/revision/assets/analyses/sequences/deliverables.
Events support source_in, source_remainder, freeze, speed_curve, keyframes; semantic checks belong to fc_core.validate.
decision: Design migration/capability overlay, not a competing project schema.
counterexample: JSON shape alone admits cases rejected by semantic validator.
test: Schema and semantic-validator agreement fixtures: NOT_RUN.
limitations: Not an operation transaction schema.

title: FrameCut semantic validation and immutable revisions
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Runtime VERSION is 1.1.0, distinct from package version and project schema.
Timeline uses rational FPS and integer frames; source time is asset PTS.
Closed operation envelope, stale revisions, protected base-clip IDs and immutable history are enforced.
decision: Keep native revision transaction and validate final candidate before save.
counterexample: Clip locks do not automatically protect every overlay or sound decision.
test: Stale revision, lock, orphan anchor, hash mutation: existing tests inspected, NOT_RUN.
limitations: No native transaction id/idempotency key; repeated stale retry fails, not deduplicates.

title: FrameCut native editing operations
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Nine native ops cover split, trim, move, remove, freeze, keyframes, speed curve, effects and framing.
Ripple conflicts with straddling absolute events are rejected; explicit dependent policies exist.
decision: Map additional NLE operations to tested expansions or future explicit primitives.
counterexample: A generic set_sequence can replace state but does not establish roll/slip/slide semantics.
test: Atomic multi-op conflict, ripple all lanes, source-window preservation: NOT_RUN.
limitations: No first-class insert/overwrite/roll/slip/slide/track targeting/multicam in inspected operation set.

title: FrameCut exact time maps and animation
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Speed curve uses rational speed points and exact integral; allowed 1/4..4.
Split/trim retain sub-PTS remainder and animation offset.
Inverse curve uses 64 bisection steps; FFmpeg expression serializes decimals.
decision: Preserve exact planning clock; quantify render-boundary approximation.
counterexample: Reverse and optical-flow retiming are not implied by a speed curve.
test: Split ramp and boundary-word mapping plus decoded-frame comparison: NOT_RUN.
limitations: Approximation remains at backend decimal expression and sampled output.

title: FrameCut motion binding and QA
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Motion request includes project/revision hashes, local start 0, exact duration/FPS, global start, dimensions, alpha and SDR bt709 declaration.
Binding verifies baseline context, media hash, frame count, rate, dimensions and requested alpha.
Technical pass and delivery readiness differ; full recorded picture/audio review is required for READY.
decision: Extend existing motion request conservatively; preserve explicit review coverage.
counterexample: Recorded full-review booleans are assertions, not proof of sensory inspection.
test: Stale return, wrong alpha, changed context, preview-vs-final: NOT_RUN.
limitations: Color declaration is not a complete validated color-management contract; runtime tests NOT_RUN.

title: FrameCut CLI and editorial export
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Export produces native project/relink/CSV, and supported picture EDL/OTIO.
Transitions/retimes/freeze withhold EDL/OTIO; style/layers/audio omissions are recorded.
OTIO read/write check compares duration to end of last base clip; named-editor import is explicitly NOT_RUN.
decision: Require semantic and NLE round-trip suite before interoperability promise.
counterexample: Equal duration can conceal changed source in/out, lost track or trailing gap.
test: Trailing gap, mixed rates, source PTS, layers and real NLE reimport: NOT_RUN.
limitations: Observed code behavior only; no adapter execution.

title: Existing Studio owner map
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: FrameCut is stable opencut-video-studio owner of editing, source maps, revisions, local composition and delivery.
Caption Studio handles craft/QA; Motion Graphics local motion/sound implementation; Audio Production direction.
One Project State, brief, master clock and bounded review are retained.
decision: New FrameCut/FrameMotion should preserve responsibility map and shared context.
counterexample: Specialist invocation does not prove a second agent or tool executed.
test: Cross-owner request/return revision fixture: NOT_RUN.
limitations: External new-plugin repositories were not supplied and are Unknown.

title: Caption Studio responsibilities and FrameCut handoff
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Caption craft, readability, timing-source authority and caption QA already have an owner.
Source words and corrections remain separate; translation cannot reuse original-language word timestamps.
decision: Reuse Caption Studio; FrameCut projects caption timing once.
counterexample: Segment ASR cannot establish accurate active-word timing.
test: Partial words, untranslated/translated timing, Unicode glyphs and collisions: NOT_RUN.
limitations: Platform recommendations here not independently revalidated; no universal safe-zone assertion made.

title: Audio ownership and sound-to-picture
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Audio Production retains direction/music/voice/rights and review; Motion Graphics implements authorized procedural sound.
FrameCut owns global placement and does not shorten picture to smooth sound.
One motion route declares -14 LUFS, while FrameCut supports requested deliverable target.
decision: Keep target contextual; do not promote motion default into universal delivery rule.
counterexample: Broadcast or differently specified deliverable may need another loudness target.
test: Measure actual final plus listen; NOT_RUN.
limitations: This source defines Studio workflow, not international loudness standards.

title: Companion routing and verified intake
author: FrameCoreWorks

Companion intake hashes output and matches request, but does not inspect/hear media.

counterexample: Verified file hash does not prove editorial suitability or licence.
test: Wrong task ID/hash/provider fixture and actual media inspection: NOT_RUN.

limitations: No Toolbox execution in this study.

title: Native FrameCut regression specifications
author: FrameCoreWorks
claims: Repository tests cover exact split clock, atomic conflicting ripple, freeze/ramp, preview-vs-video, storyboard, durable jobs and dry-run.
decision: Extend existing fixture family before adding new edit semantics.

title: OpenTimelineIO timeline structure
author: AcademySoftwareFoundation
claims: OTIO separates clips/media references, available and source ranges, tracks/stacks/gaps/transitions.
Transition does not change overall track duration.

decision: Use OTIO as interchange IR, not renderer or complete media validator.
counterexample: A syntactically valid timeline can refer to unavailable media handles.
test: Gap/transition handles and source-range round-trip: NOT_RUN.
limitations: OTIO_VERSION at inspected main says 0.19.0; latest docs banner 0.19.0.dev1, not asserted release equivalence.

counterexample: Core import success does not prove AAF/FCPXML plugin availability.
test: Missing adapter typed capability result, save/read comparison: NOT_RUN.
limitations: External adapters have separate pins and coverage.
